items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: I had an offer from Dave Payton, had the band in the Grand Theater.

ctx.x: When your oldest boy was born.

Yeah, when my oldest boy was born, see. Then, I done had just about as much soaking as I wanted in that line of business. When I came here in Chicago, I had offers from Charlie Cook. He had a band, Patty Harmon's Dreamland Hems, Westside. I had an offer from Dave Payton, had the band in the Grand Theater. I had offers from two, three bands.
